lessons.title: By the lake
lessons.en:
Anna: It's a sunny Saturday! Let's have a picnic.
Ben: Great! I'll bring sandwiches and juice.
Anna: I have a big basket. We can sit by the lake.
Ben: Let's invite Tom and Lily to share with us.
Anna: Yes, the more, the merrier!
lessons.cn:
安娜：阳光明媚的周六，我们去野餐吧！
本：好！我带三明治和果汁。
安娜：我有个大篮子，我们可以坐在湖边。
本：叫上汤姆和莉莉一起。
安娜：好，人越多越热闹！

lessons.title: Picnic by the lake
lessons.en: Last Sunday we had a wonderful picnic by the lake. The sun was warm and the water was blue. We put a big mat on the grass and opened our baskets. There were sandwiches, fruit, juice and cookies. We shared everything and laughed a lot. A picnic with friends is the best part of spring.
lessons.cn: 上周日我们在湖边野餐，玩得很开心。阳光暖暖，湖水蓝蓝。我们在草地上铺好大垫子，打开篮子。里面有三明治、水果、果汁和饼干。我们彼此分享，笑个不停。和朋友野餐是春天最棒的事。
